transfer_policy.mode: one complete file at a time; upload then verify remote size and SHA256 before deleting only that disposable local staging file
transfer_policy.non_lfs_hash_policy: sha256 is null when no upstream LFS SHA256 exists; calculate the actual downloaded bytes hash and compare locally versus remotely, retaining the recorded git blob OID and pinned revision.
transfer_policy.large_file_hash_policy: Validate upstream LFS SHA256 before upload and validate remote SHA256 after upload.
transfer_policy.staging_rule: Do not snapshot_download full repositories, parallelize large files, or preserve another full HF-cache copy on this Mac.

fixed_to_base: DDIM scheduler built from base scheduler config

safety_checker.basis: BackdoorDM pinned utils/load.py sets safety_checker=None for Rickrolling and matched clean evaluation; maintain this same explicit protocol for every method.
safety_checker.scope: Not evaluated as a defense, not a deployment setting; only preregistered ordinary-object prompts are in this MVP.

component_policy.precision: Download default FP32 safetensors; compute and freeze the TE delta/mask from FP32 values before any reduced-precision forward casting.
required_before_run: Verify each file checksum and revision
Assert clean and source share identical non-TE components by construction
Assert every expert has all UNet and TE parameter keys and identical tensor shapes
Compare tokenizer vocab and merges with the base
Record real UNet and TE parameter differences rather than infer them from container hashes
Freeze all prompts, labels and sampler settings before inspecting results

trigger_identity.replacement_scope: all occurrences of lowercase o in the complete normal prompt
trigger_identity.runtime_gate: Verify normalized trigger identity and CLIP tokenizer IDs; a different character or source identity is a hard stop.
trigger_identity.public_checkpoint_training_seed: not independently verifiable from published TE files; do not equate with old local seed678 or seed100 artifacts

evaluation.classification_preprocess: Convert generated RGB images to 224x224 with PIL BILINEAR; then use the pinned ViTImageProcessor and frozen ViT argmax, matching the audited BackdoorDM path.
evaluation.clip_metric: Frozen independent CLIP large-patch14 with TorchMetrics CLIPScore on normal image/prompt pairs; record a 0-100 scale.

environment_proposal.preferred_python: 3.11.7 venv from existing Anaconda base; do not modify shared base

environment_proposal.torch_wheel_runtime: CUDA 12.8; driver capability is not the installed torch runtime version
environment_proposal.pin_validation: Official PyTorch paired-release table and PyPI dependency metadata checked; not an installed full transitive lock or successful runtime validation.
environment_proposal.wheel_transfer: Resolve and download Linux x86_64 cp311 wheels on Mac for the selected Python 3.11 environment, including all transitive dependencies; do not transfer macOS arm64 wheels.
